facts.business: Ludlow Jute & Specialities Limited is engaged in the manufacture and sale of jute goods.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The outlook for the jute industry remains cautiously optimistic with improved raw material availability, steady Government demand, and gradual revival of the domestic market expected to support stable and positive outlook.

key_risks: Competition from Synthetic and Imported Products
facts.related_party_note: During Financial Year 2025-2026, the Company entered into transactions with Related Parties in ordinary course of its business at arm's length. The Audit Committee reviews all related party transactions quarterly.
